t: You're on Denmark Hill, a street running through the boroughs of Southwark and Lambeth. Its name comes from Prince George of Denmark, Duke of Cumberland. He was the husband of Queen Anne, who reigned over Great Britain from 1702. George was consort to the monarch from her accession in March 1702 until his death in 1708. So the name of this street recalls a prince who, for the last six years of his life, was married to the queen.
